name: Alessia Bellini
bio:
Alessia Bellini's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially trained as a restorer of antique furniture, her meticulous attention to detail and steady hand caught the eye of a local racing team needing someone to apply intricate livery designs. She quickly adapted her skills, mastering the nuances of automotive paints and finishes. Her passion lies in creating visually stunning and durable paint jobs that not only look great but also withstand the rigors of racing. 

Alessia is known for her unwavering commitment to quality and her deep understanding of color theory. She's constantly experimenting with new techniques and materials to improve the appearance and performance of race cars. While she prefers to work independently, she's always willing to share her knowledge and expertise with others. She has a reputation for being incredibly particular, often demanding the highest standards from herself and her materials, which some find challenging but all respect.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail, with a few strands escaping to frame her face.
physical.description: Alessia is of average height with a focused and intense gaze.

quirks: Insists on using only Italian-made paint brushes.
Always wears a pair of bright pink noise-canceling headphones while working, even when it's quiet.
Has a small espresso machine permanently installed in her paint booth.
